map.换算关系：1 英里=1.609344 公里，因子 f(公里)=1、t(英里)=1:
The conversion is 1 mile = 1.609344 km, so the factor f(km)=1 and t(mile)=1.609344.
The formula is r = v x f / t. Entering v=5 min/km: r = 5x1/1.609344 = 3. ...
